automation.title: Automation
automation.summary: A CRM workflow automation rule with triggers, conditions, and actions.
automation.description: Defines a CRM workflow automation. When a triggering event fires (e.g. lead_created, contact_created, lead_stage_changed, marketing_segment_match), the rule's conditions are evaluated against the entity data; if all match, the configured actions are executed in order. Backed by OpenRegister's WebhookService for webhook actions and WorkflowEngineRegistry for DMN decision evaluation.

name.description: Display name of the automation rule.

trigger.description: CRM event that activates this automation.

triggerConditions.description: Key-value filter conditions that must all match before actions run (AND logic). Strings compare case-insensitively.

actions.description: Ordered list of action objects executed in sequence when the trigger matches. Supported action types: assign_lead, move_stage, send_notification, add_note, fire_webhook, update_tag, apply_decision.

isActive.description: Whether the automation is enabled and considered when events fire.

lastRun.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent execution.

webhookUrl.description: Optional external webhook (e.g. n8n) URL fired by this automation.

n8nWorkflowId.description: Optional reference to an n8n workflow ID this automation hands off to.

automationLog.title: Automation Log
automationLog.summary: An audit trail entry for one automation execution.
automationLog.description: Records a single automation invocation: which automation fired, what entity triggered it, what actions executed (and their per-action result), and overall success/failure. Used by the runtime variable query API and the automation history view.

automation.description: UUID or slug reference to the automation that executed.

triggerEntity.description: UUID or slug of the CRM entity (lead, contact, request) that triggered the run.

actionsExecuted.description: Per-action execution log with type, result, and optional extra fields like httpStatus or error.

error.description: Error message captured if the execution failed.
